subject: Deploy PR 642 Candidate 01 4W runtime to Design resident only
body: Run the exact PR #642 head in an isolated macOS worktree and repoint only the local Doré Design resident. Do not merge PR #642, do not alter or publish the homepage, and do not implement Second Layer worlds.

argv: curl -fsS 'http://127.0.0.1:4310/editor-canvas?page=living-water-candidate-01' | grep -q 'candidate-01-living-editorial-runtime' && curl -fsS 'http://127.0.0.1:4310/editor-canvas?page=living-water-candidate-01' | grep -q '4W Living Editorial River' && curl -fsS 'http://127.0.0.1:4310/editor-canvas?page=living-water-candidate-01' | grep -q 'dore.visual-editorial-director.v1'

python3 - <<'PY'
import json,urllib.request
base='http://127.0.0.1:4310'
h=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(base+'/api/health'))
c=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(base+'/api/design-candidates/living-water-01'))
html=urllib.request.urlopen(base+'/editor-canvas?page=living-water-candidate-01').read().decode()
print(json.dumps({'ok':True,'deployed_sha':'1988ed5b6734c0098eaa58ea522cb309f3e965c2','health':h,'candidate':c,'visual_director':'dore.visual-editorial-director.v1' in html,'living_editorial_river':'4W Living Editorial River' in html,'runtime':'candidate-01-living-editorial-runtime' in html},ensure_ascii=False))
